title: Dragonflight
author: Anne McCaffrey
summary: On a world menaced by deadly spores falling from a wandering star, the dragonriders are few and the other holds have grown complacent. A dispossessed young woman is swept into the riders' ranks when a queen dragon chooses her.
readIf: you love dragons that bond with their riders and want a classic of the genre from the late sixties.
skipIf: you want modern romance or gender politics, as some attitudes in this book feel distinctly dated.

pairings.reason: A more recent and younger dragon-and-rider bond story that owes a lot to this book.
Also built around riders and their dragons, but a fast, romance-forward and far bloodier take.
A more sprawling epic if you want a bigger and more political secondary world.
